name: Sangomon
main_effect: [On Play] By placing this Digimon as the bottom digivolution card of any of your other Digimon with [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any of their traits, until your opponent's turn ends, that Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and can't be deleted in battle.
source_effect: ＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
